title: CIA-UAP-017, Placement on High Alert Due to Perceived Aggressive Foreign Posturing
doc_notes: This is a CIA intelligence report regarding a UAP sighting in Zimbabwe in July 2008, which resulted in the country being placed on high alert; the document contains significant redactions.

incidents.summary: An unidentified object was observed hovering at high altitude over Harare International Airport, exhibiting beams and rotating lights before ascending rapidly.
incidents.quote: the object was disc-like in shape with a hollow center, and had a series of rotating lights on the underside of the airframe
